title: cymbopogon munroi
intro: Cymbopogon munroi, commonly known as Lemon Myrtle, is a type of tropical grass native to Australia, characterized by its aromatic leaves and distinctive lemon scent. The health benefits of Lemon Myrtle include its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which can help soothe digestive issues, reduce stress, and protect against cell damage. Therapeutically, Lemon Myrtle is used in aromatherapy to promote relaxation, reduce anxiety, and improve mood, as well as in traditional medicine to treat various ailments, including fever and skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of Lemon Myrtle include citral, geraniol, and limonene, which contribute to its medicinal and therapeutic properties.
